title: The inhibitory effect of DIF-3 on polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid-induced innate immunity activation in human cerebral microvascular endothelial cells.
authors: Araya, Ryusei; Men, Shihu; Uekusa, Yoshinori; Yu, Zaiqiang; Kikuchi, Haruhisa; Daitoku, Kazuyuki; Minakawa, Masahito; Kawaguchi, Shogo; Furukawa, Ken-Ichi; Oshima, Yoshiteru; Imaizumi, Tadaatsu; Seya, Kazuhiko
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DIF-3抑制poly IC诱导的脑微血管内皮细胞先天免疫激活，涉及NF-kB p65磷酸化及分子对接，但核心是免疫信号通路而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: For the treatment and prevention of autoinflammatory diseases, it is essential to develop the drug, regulating the innate immune system. Although differentiation-inducing factor (DIF) derivatives, extracted from the cellular slime mold, Dictyostelium discoideum, exhibit immunomodulatory effects, their effects on the regulation of innate immunity in brain are unknown. In this study, we used the human cerebral microvascular endothelial cell line, hCMEC/D3, to investigate the effects of DIF derivatives on the generation of C-X-C motif chemokine (CXCL) 10 and interferon (IFN)-beta induced by polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid (poly IC). DIF-3 (1-10 muM), but not DIF-1 and DIF-2, dose-dependently inhibited the biosynthesis of not only CXCL10 but also CXCL16 and C-C motif chemokine 2 induced by poly IC. DIF-3 also strongly decreased IFN-beta mRNA expression and protein release from the cells induced by poly IC through the prohibition of p65, a subtype of NF-kB, not interferon regulatory transcription factor 3 phosphorylation. In the docking simulation study, we confirmed that DIF-3 had a high affinity to p65. These results suggest that DIF-3 regulates the innate immune system by inhibiting TLR3/IFN-beta signaling axis through the NF-kB phosphorylation inhibition.
abstract_zh: 为了治疗和预防自身炎症性疾病，开发调节先天免疫系统的药物至关重要。尽管从细胞黏菌盘基网柄菌（Dictyostelium discoideum）中提取的分化诱导因子（differentiation-inducing factor, DIF）衍生物表现出免疫调节作用，但它们对脑内先天免疫调节的影响尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们使用人脑微血管内皮细胞系hCMEC/D3，探讨了DIF衍生物对聚肌苷酸-聚胞苷酸（polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid, poly IC）诱导的C-X-C基序趋化因子（C-X-C motif chemokine, CXCL）10和干扰素（interferon, IFN）-β生成的影响。DIF-3（1-10 μM），而非DIF-1和DIF-2，剂量依赖性地抑制了poly IC诱导的不仅CXCL10，还有CXCL16和C-C基序趋化因子2的生物合成。DIF-3还通过抑制p65（NF-kB的一个亚型）而非干扰素调节转录因子3的磷酸化，强烈降低了poly IC诱导的细胞中IFN-β mRNA表达和蛋白释放。在对接模拟研究中，我们确认DIF-3对p65具有高亲和力。这些结果表明，DIF-3通过抑制NF-kB磷酸化来调节TLR3/IFN-β信号轴，从而调控先天免疫系统。
